tests.title: Register a new account with unique valid credentials redirects to sign-in and the new credentials sign in after reload
checks: Visitor opens Sign in then Create an account and sees Username, Email, Password, Confirm password, Agree to the terms, Create account
Enters pw-user-<unique suffix>, an @example.test email, Valid-password-123!, matching confirmation, checks terms, clicks Create account
Redirects to sign-in without displaying password; account email is verified and usable for sign-in and recovery
Signing in with the new email enters workspace and the account menu shows the username after reload

tests.title: Submit multiple invalid registration fields shows all field errors together and preserves attempted username/email without creating an account
checks: Enter a username beginning with hyphen, email not-an-email, password short, confirmation different, and leave terms unchecked
Field messages appear together: Username format is invalid, Email format is invalid, Password requirements are not satisfied, Agree to terms is required
Username and email inputs retain the attempted values and the submit button remains actionable
Reopening the registration page shows no account was created for the attempted values

tests.title: Register with a duplicate username and a different unused email shows Username already exists, retains both attempted values, and creates no account
checks: Enter the seeded username alice-dev with a different unused email and otherwise valid inputs
Displays Username already exists beside the username field and retains the attempted username and email
No account is created for the new email; signing in with the new email fails
The existing alice-dev account remains unchanged and can still sign in

tests.title: Sign in with a username enters the workspace, shows the username in the account menu, and the session persists after refresh and direct protected-page access
checks: Enter alice-dev in Username or email and Valid-password-123! in Password, click Sign in
Redirects to the user's workspace and the account menu displays alice-dev
Refreshing the workspace or directly reopening a protected organization/repository page keeps the signed-in user
Failed sign-in remains on the sign-in page and does not display the account menu

tests.title: Sign in with the verified email enters the same workspace and keeps the signed-in session after reopening protected pages
checks: Enter alice.dev@example.test in Username or email and Valid-password-123! in Password, click Sign in
Workspace opens and the account menu displays alice-dev
Authorized organizations, repositories, and work items are accessible
Refreshing or reopening a protected page still shows the signed-in user

tests.title: Unknown username and incorrect password both return exactly Invalid credentials, create no session, and leave protected pages unauthenticated
checks: Submit an unknown username or an incorrect password with alice-dev
Exactly the generic message Invalid credentials is displayed, without revealing which credential was wrong
The sign-in page remains displayed and no account menu appears
Refreshing or opening a protected page still requires authentication

tests.title: Unavailable account returns Invalid credentials, preserves no session, and the protected page remains inaccessible after refresh
checks: Submit credentials for a seeded unavailable account with its correct password
Displays exactly Invalid credentials and does not create a session
No account menu appears and the user is not redirected to a workspace
Opening a previously accessible protected page after refresh still requires authentication

tests.title: Recover a registered account with code 123456 updates the password while the unknown email follows the same step without modifying any account
checks: Open Forgot password, submit the registered email alice.dev@example.test, and directly see the fixed code 123456 plus Password reset fields
Enter 123456, Replacement-password-456!, matching confirmation, and Reset password; displays Password updated
Sign-in with the old password fails and sign-in with the new password succeeds
The unknown email also opens the same next step with code 123456 but does not change any account; no email or link is produced

tests.title: Incorrect verification code 000000 displays Verification code is invalid and leaves the old password usable
checks: Submit a registered email and enter code 000000 with a compliant new password and matching confirmation
Displays Verification code is invalid beside the code field and does not display Password updated
The account password is unchanged; old password still signs in and the candidate new password does not
State remains unchanged after reload and no email or link is generated

tests.title: Noncompliant new password or mismatched confirmation explains the reason beside the field and does not modify credentials
checks: Submit a registered email with correct code 123456 but a noncompliant new password or a mismatched confirmation
Field error appears for password/confirmation and no password is updated
Old password continues to work and the candidate new password does not
Refreshing the reset page keeps the same flow without sending email or creating a second account

tests.title: Confirming sign-out invalidates the current browser session and protected pages require re-authentication after refresh, back, or direct open
checks: Signed-in user opens Account menu and clicks Sign out, then Confirm sign out in the Sign out dialog
Returns to unauthenticated state, displays the Sign in entry, and no longer shows the user's account menu
Refreshing, browser back, or directly reopening the recorded protected page requires authentication and cannot restore the session

tests.title: Cancel or close the sign-out dialog keeps the current session valid and the original protected page accessible
checks: Signed-in user opens Account menu, clicks Sign out, and selects Cancel or closes the dialog
No session invalidation occurs; account menu still shows the current user
The original protected page remains accessible and persists after refresh
Confirming later is still possible, but only confirmation invalidates the session

tests.title: Update password with correct current password and matching confirmation shows Password updated and makes only the new password valid
checks: Signed-in alice-dev opens Settings > Password and authentication
Enter current Valid-password-123!, New-password-456!, matching confirmation, click Update password
Displays Password updated; after sign-out the new password signs in and the old password fails
Refreshing/reopening the security page does not revert the password change

tests.title: Incorrect current password with mismatched confirmation shows the current-password/confirmation error and leaves old credentials usable
checks: Enter an incorrect current password, a compliant new password, and confirmation does-not-match, then click Update password
Displays Current password is incorrect and/or Password confirmation does not match beside the corresponding field
No password record is modified; old Valid-password-123! still signs in and the candidate new password does not
State remains unchanged after reload

tests.title: Missing current password displays Current password is required and does not change the account password
checks: Leave Current password empty, enter Required-password-789! and matching confirmation, click Update password
Displays Current password is required beside the current-password field
The stored password remains unchanged; old password still works and Required-password-789! cannot sign in
Only the current account's password record is affected and no other accounts are changed
